stem.text: Carboxylic acids may be prepared by several different methods.
In which reaction would propanoic acid be formed?

A.text: adding ammonium propanoate to dilute sulfuric acid

B.text: heating ethyl propanoate with aqueous sodium hydroxide

C.text: heating propan-2-ol with acidified potassium manganate(VII) under reflux

D.text: heating propyl ethanoate with dilute sulfuric acid
